title: Bojie Dy defends multi-purpose buildings in 2027 budget
summary: House Speaker Faustino "Bojie" Dy III has defended the inclusion of multi-purpose buildings in the House-approved version of the proposed 2027 national budget, saying these structures could serve…

blocks.text: House Speaker Faustino "Bojie" Dy III has defended the inclusion of multi-purpose buildings in the House-approved version of the proposed 2027 national budget, saying these structures could serve various community needs.
In a report on GMA's 24 Oras on Saturday, Dy said multi-purpose buildings could be used as barangay halls, community centers and other facilities.
Dy said lawmakers, as representatives of their respective districts, were responsible for informing the national government of their constituents' needs.

“Pagka sinabi mo na multi-purpose hall, pwede po ito yung barangay hall or pwede po yung multi-purpose center… Kaya naman po yung atin namang limited sources sa national funding ay ating pong inilalaan sa mga iba’t-ibang pangangailangan ng ating distrito,” Dy said.
(When you say multi-purpose hall, this could be a barangay hall or a multi-purpose center. We allocate our limited national government funding to the various needs of our districts.)

The inclusion of multi-purpose buildings in the proposed budget has drawn scrutiny, particularly over the substantial amounts allocated for their construction and the uneven distribution of projects among local government units (LGUs).
Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson earlier pointed out that most of the proposed multi-purpose buildings were allocated to wealthier LGUs, while poorer localities received fewer projects.— MCG, GMA News
